experiment.name: climax-leak
experiment.question: Is the C7 climax leak fixable by a workflow change (redact ending from planner lookahead) or a stronger planner model, without regressing other cases?
experiment.metric: qa-bench 11-set hard-PASS rate (grade.ts); primary target C7 pass-rate over 3 trials
experiment.threshold_rule: C7 >= 2/3 AND 11-set total not regressed AND held-out regresses 0.

_armB_killed_on_dev.note: gemini-3.5-flash planner: C7 0/3, total 0.909/0.636/0.909 (regressed) — falsified on dev, not run on held-out. See conclusion table.

verdict.rationale: armA (workflow redact-ending) closed C7 0/3 -> 3/3 on dev with no regression (11/11 twice) and generalized on held-out (T14 climax question FAIL->PASS; T13 holds). armB (gemini-3.5-flash) FALSIFIED: C7 still 0/3 AND destabilized the set (one trial 7/11) -> C7 is structural, not model-tier. Held-out aggregate flat (5/6) only due to T16, a false regression: T16 is paused at the last scene so next_scenes=[] and the redact flag cannot touch its input; it failed on the qa-answer (persona, orthogonal to the change) = noise. Ship armA, kill armB.
